app-insights-multistep-legacy.title: Multi-step web tests are a legacy test type
app-insights-multistep-legacy.body: This estimate includes multi-step web tests. Microsoft documents Standard tests as the supported availability test type for current monitoring, with multi-step tests only in previous-version documentation, so plan to replace them with Standard tests.

citation.quote: Application Insights supports Standard tests for current availability monitoring

app-insights-commitment-tier.title: High telemetry volume can use a commitment tier
app-insights-commitment-tier.body: This estimate ingests about 100 GB a day or more of telemetry at pay-as-you-go rates. Workspace commitment tiers start at 100 GB per day and cost less per GB than pay-as-you-go, so compare them for a workspace-based Application Insights resource.

citation.source: Azure Monitor Logs cost calculation and options
citation.quote: With commitment tier pricing, you can commit to buy data ingestion for a workspace, starting at 100 GB per day, at a lower price than pay-as-you-go pricing.

app-insights-sampling.title: Sampling can cut high telemetry volume
app-insights-sampling.body: This estimate ingests 100 GB a month or more of telemetry. Microsoft lists sampling as the way to tune the amount of data Application Insights collects, which directly reduces the ingestion cost.

citation.quote: Use sampling to tune the amount of data collected.
